name: lorevid
niche: anime theories, breakdowns and What If stories

series.name: One Piece
series.release: New manga chapter most Sundays on MANGA Plus (check for break weeks; 1195 is Oct 11, 2026). Anime paused after episode 1180 and returns in 2027.
series.credit: One Piece © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation. Stills and manga panels via the One Piece Wiki (Fandom).

series.name: Naruto / Boruto
series.release: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex manga chapter monthly (around the 20th). Naruto is evergreen: What If stories do best.
series.credit: Naruto © Masashi Kishimoto / Shueisha / Studio Pierrot. Boruto: Two Blue Vortex © Ukyo Kodachi, Mikio Ikemoto / Shueisha. Stills and manga panels via Narutopedia (Fandom).

series.name: Jujutsu Kaisen
series.release: Main manga finished (2024); JJK Modulo spin-off ended March 2026. Anime season 4 (Culling Game part 2) in production, no date. Evergreen: Gojo/Sukuna What Ifs, Sukuna POV, power-scaling and mechanics questions do best.
series.credit: Jujutsu Kaisen © Gege Akutami / Shueisha / MAPPA. Stills and manga panels via the Jujutsu Kaisen Wiki (Fandom).

banned_phrases: to understand how we get there

short.note: 35-60 s vertical: one sharp claim or story beat, evidence, payoff, last line loops into the first

long.note: 13-16 min (the pipeline reads ~200 wpm, so 2600+ words): What If story or theory breakdown; payoff teased in 5 s, re-hook every 2-3 min

fair_use_note: Fan-made commentary and theory, not affiliated with the creators. All anime and manga images belong to their rights holders and are used here for commentary and discussion.
